name: broke-o-meter
description: Aplikasi pencatat pengeluaran harian offline-first dengan indikator level boncos, ekspor PDF, backup JSON, dan integrasi Android via Capacitor.

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && powershell -Command "if (-not $env:JAVA_HOME) { $env:JAVA_HOME = 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft\jdk-21.0.12.101-hotspot'; $env:Path = \"$env:JAVA_HOME\bin;$env:Path\" }; .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug"

author: Tedsani
